ideas.topic: The Mystery of the Missing Pyramid Capstones
ideas.hook: We’ve found thousands of statues, but where did the gold-covered pyramid tips actually go?
ideas.why: It leverages the 'unexplained mystery' trope that drives high-view counts while maintaining a focus on archaeological gaps.

ideas.topic: Ancient Egyptian Makeup: More Than Just Aesthetics
ideas.hook: The heavy black eyeliner worn by Pharaohs wasn't just for looks—it was a literal life-saving medicine.
ideas.why: It taps into the audience's curiosity about daily life and health practices, similar to the high-performing mummy decomposition videos.

ideas.topic: The Impossible Geometry of the Great Sphinx
ideas.hook: How did ancient builders align a massive stone lion with the rising sun using only copper tools?
ideas.why: It addresses the 'Ancient Technology' intrigue seen in top-performing shorts while grounding the video in historical construction methods.
